correctness.rationale: A binary colouring is one-step majority-fixed in a cubic graph exactly when its bichromatic cut is a matching. For each k=1,2,3 the cyclic window automaton on 4^(2k) words enforces both centre-vertex majority conditions bijectively for n>2k. Independent construction found node/edge counts (16,20),(256,320),(4096,5120), cyclic strongly-connected sizes [4,1,1],[24,1,1],[124,1,1], and computed the characteristic polynomial of the 124-state k=3 component exactly as t^58(t-1)P32(t)P33(t) with both published coefficient vectors. Independent positive-vector computations from A^38*1 and A^37*1 certify the strict rational Collatz-Wielandt intervals 1.56485..1.56486 and 1.5965..1.5966; the dominant components have self-loops and are primitive. Exhaustive independent direct-state counts through n=10 give [32,32,32], [48,48,72], [76,76,52], [124,118,124]. Thus alpha2<alpha3<phi and exact all-size root-sum formula follow by the transfer bijection, not extrapolation.
